data.name: Everforge Legacy
data.detailed_description:
Everforge Legacy is a classic Action RPG solo experience, built for players who remember when a world felt like it had secrets worth finding. With 6 Jobs to master and over 200 abilities to experiment with, mix 8 active Abilities to create any Job blend you can think of. Will you be a Warrior Monk powerhouse, a pure Red Mage, or a Black Mage Thief stealing in the night? The world of Everforge Legacy is a dangerous place, beset by ancient horrors, unholy undead, and of course, killer bunnies. Every good RPG must have them.

Somewhere beneath the corruption, beneath the ruined forges, the restless dead, and the things stirring in places they should not be stirring, is a civilization that built something extraordinary and made one catastrophic mistake trying to reach too far. The artifacts, the glyphs, the ancient shrines that no one has been able to explain: they are not ruins. They are a message. And someone has been working very hard to make sure it is never read.

Throughout your adventure, you will come across varying friends and foes alike.  You'll find that a mind-warped clan of Giant Trolls has taken over Blackgrim Swamp and an ancient and long-dead Pirate Captain has returned to find his treasure once more.  A friendly clan of Dwarven smiths may help you on your journey whereas the Human settlements in the mountains will require your aid.  

Three Paths, Three Campaigns

Begin your adventure as a sturdy Dwarf, an agile Elf, or a wise Human. You're not picking just a character, but a full on path to walk. Each path has its own zones, its own people, its own story:

  • Dwarven — Highland Plateau. Something stirs beneath the stone. The lower tunnels have gone quiet, tools left behind, no bodies, no answers, and the Dwarves are too stubborn to admit they're afraid.

  • Elven — Silvercrest Enclave. The forest remembers what the living have forgotten. Small duties for the Enclave's priestesses give way to something older. The dead in the Grove are no longer resting, and the trail leads across open water to a rainforest outpost, then down into a pirate den where the bones are older than the pirates who buried their plunder there.

  • Human — Miram Drift. The cold doesn't care who you are. Come anyway. A quiet opening on a forgotten mountain - gathering supplies, staying alive - turns grim fast when a second camp is found buried in the snow, bodies half-covered, with no explanation. The trail leads down into warmer hills riddled with the stench of death, and up again into a frozen cliff where something patient has been waiting.

Explore Thal'myr.  Find your way through this world of hidden treasures and adventure.  The Everforge has been long dormant, but the myths and legends surrounding it continue to lull children to sleep and make would-be heroes travel across lands unknown in search of glory.
